clips.title: The story
paras: Krazek has found what you came for. After calling in favors, doing plenty of deducing and giving up a rare bottle of elven wine, Krazek wrote a letter about Nazz Steamboil. It is too dangerous for Krazek to use, so you carry it to Kravel Koalbeard, out on the Shimmering Flats, and you are asked not to say where it came from.

Krazek tells you what the search cost: some favors were used up, a rare bottle of elven wine was parted with, and a good deal of deducing was done. The result is a letter holding some very interesting bits about Nazz Steamboil. Krazek finds it too dangerous to use, and leaves it to you to do with as you will, as long as nobody learns where it came from. It goes back to Kravel Koalbeard, out on the Shimmering Flats.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had to use some of my favors, and gave away a rare bottle of elven wine, and did some heavy deducing myself! But I found the information you seek.
Here, I wrote a letter with some very interesting bits on our friend, Nazz Steamboil. Do with it what you will -- it's too dangerous for me to use.
Just don't tell anyone where you got it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get anything on Nazz Steamboil? Anything he might want to keep a secret??

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well well! This is interesting... Very interesting. Heh, perhaps I should bow to the goblin pilot the next time I see him.
This is worth plenty, friend. I'm sure Nazz will pay a small fortune to keep his secret... A secret.
